automation_settings.how_to_turn_off_asset_automation: No connector action changes these. Campaigns, the campaign, Settings, then the asset automation section, for each row marked turn off.

optimization_score.what_it_measures: Google calls it an estimate of how well the account is set to perform. It is worked out from Google's own open recommendations, so in practice it shows how fully the account follows them.
optimization_score.what_it_does_not: Results. Brand | Search scores 97% and AC Installation | Search 72%, but the score says nothing about Furnace Repair's $60 CPA against AC Installation's $183.33.
optimization_score.dismissing: The 5 dismissals here also raise the score, because a dismissed recommendation stops counting against it.
optimization_score.quality_score: Google states that Quality Score doesn't use it.

order_to_act: 1. Pause the four auto-apply types, and switch off the UNKNOWN type in Google Ads, so nothing below is undone or re-applied.
